| **Repo** | `box/ubuntu` |

The canonical, co-tenant-safe Ubuntu CI-runner recipe: the Docker daemon and its
GC/socket-heal timers, the CI userns and journald settings, and the runner tree plus
ONE parameterised registration script. Extracted from the kind: vm entity that used
to carry it as cloud-init, so the SAME recipe serves every substrate (decision D1,
opencharly/distro-ubuntu issue 37) — a KubeVirt entity used to have to re-author all
of it. Runner REGISTRATION stays an operator step: a token lives one hour and is
never committed. `charly-register-runners` takes the org, name prefix, labels and
count, so one script serves a single VM or a multi-VM fleet.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| `check` | the co-tenant CI docker daemon is listening on its own socket |
| `check` | the CI userns sysctl is applied on the guest |

| `check` | the runner tree carries NO DOCKER_HOST override, so jobs see the default socket |
| `check` | the one registration script is installed, executable and self-describing |
| `check` | node is installed and reports its version |
| `check` | the gh CLI is installed and reports its version |
| `check` | pip3 and the archive tools are present |

| `check` | skopeo is installed and reports its version |
| `check` | the runner user can open /dev/kvm when the CPU exposes virtualisation |
